docs/api.md:
# R1 contract
set_retry(extension_id, tenant_id, limit) changes only that tenant usage. Limits are integers 0..5 inclusive; reject any other value before mutation.
docs/domain.md:
# Tenant settings
Accepted R1: retry limit belongs to a tenant usage, never globally to an extension. Separate conceptual responsibilities do not require separate storage or classes.
docs/index.md:
# Current review snapshot
R1 domain.md governs tenant configuration. api.md governs release R1 behavior. roadmap.md is accepted future scope. Migration implementation is referenced but not included.
docs/roadmap.md:
# Accepted R2 target
Add automatic retry backoff in R2, after R1. It is not an R1 obligation.
